header.title: Talk to us
header.lead: Sponsorship, recruitment, press, or a question about the car. Pick the right route below and the person who can actually answer will reply.

routes.title: Who answers what
routes.lead: Writing to the right address is the fastest way to get a reply. All four are monitored by a person on the team.

items.label: Sponsorship and partnerships
items.blurb: Cash, materials, machining, software or logistics. Our partnerships lead answers these.

items.label: Joining the team
items.blurb: Open roles across every subteam, engineering and business. No prior experience expected.

items.label: Press and media
items.blurb: Interviews, imagery, and the team fact sheet. Tell us your deadline and we will work to it.

items.label: Something else
items.blurb: Questions about the car, the competition, or working with the university.
